column6: eval (() => {   const headings = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, a'));   const results = [];   headings.forEach(h => {     const text = h.textContent || '';     if (text.includes('404') && (text.includes('Found') || text.includes('Status') || text.includes('Section'))) {       results.push(text.trim());     }   });   return results.slice(0, 10).join('\n'); })()
